common_comparators.sham: Same parameter draw, initial state, OU innovations, runtime, and detector; all u_E,u_I,u_T,u_R channels are zero.
common_comparators.matched_nonpersonalized: For a future eligible N>=3 set only, construct for each subject s a leave-one-subject-out componentwise-median parameter vector from the other certified Night-1 models, freeze it before evaluation, and apply the same fixed-grid policy-selection algorithm. Current status: NOT_ESTIMABLE.
common_comparators.wrong_subject: For a future eligible N>=3 set only, sort subjects by SHA256(campaign_id+'|'+subject_id), cyclically shift the selected subject-specific policy by one position, and apply the shifted policy to the recipient's own model with paired randomness. Current status: NOT_ESTIMABLE.
common_comparators.subject_interaction: On disjoint evaluation seeds define target-oriented policy benefit G_s(P). Let P_s, P_pop, and P_wrong(s) be selected by the exact target-specific policy object and tie rule: requested-value mappings for T1/T7 and single conditions for other targets. Report I_pop=median_s[G_s(P_s)-G_s(P_pop)] and I_wrong=median_s[G_s(P_s)-G_s(P_wrong(s))], plus R_between=median pairwise L2 distance between standardized subject response curves divided by the median within-subject bootstrap curve distance. Current N=0/minimum 3 remains NOT_ESTIMABLE.

common_statistics.phase2a_uncertainty: Paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, PCG64(860216), resampling parameter draws then paired seeds; two-sided 95% interval.
common_statistics.phase2b_uncertainty: Nested paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, PCG64(860219), resampling subjects, then within-subject parameter/posterior draws and paired seeds; simultaneous two-sided 95% intervals.
common_statistics.test: Exact target-specific Monte Carlo tests are bound to phase2_protocol.json#uncertainty_and_statistics/exact_hypothesis_tests. T1-T6 and descriptive T8 use 100000 one-sided paired sign flips with target-specific PCG64 seeds; T7 uses 100000 within-block circular-label permutations with PCG64(860217); p=(B+1)/(100000+1), equality counts as extreme.
common_statistics.primary_multiplicity: Exact Holm step-down at alpha=0.05 over T1,T4,T6: ascending raw p, lexical target_id tie, max-prefix adjusted p, strict adjusted p<0.05.
common_statistics.secondary_multiplicity: Open only if at least one primary passes its complete decision; then exact Holm over T2,T3,T5,T7 with the same ordering/tie/adjustment rules. Otherwise descriptive.
common_statistics.exploratory_multiplicity: T8 is descriptive/exploratory and ineligible for V4 advancement.
common_statistics.formal_c2_interaction_threshold: Both I_pop and I_wrong lower simultaneous 95% confidence bounds must exceed 0.25 sham-standard-deviation units and R_between lower 95% bound must exceed 1.5.
common_statistics.target_decision_family: F_TARGET_DECISIONS contains every registered scalar target margin across T1-T8 and uses 10000 paired hierarchical resamples from PCG64(860218), a studentized max-absolute-deviation statistic, and the 9501st order statistic. Every listed scalar lower band must exceed zero; Holm p-values are separate.
common_statistics.level_b_family: F_LEVEL_B_SURFACES contains every executed cell C_i(u)-1 plus five mapping G_i(P)-1 members for selected T1/T7: K=25*n25+20*n20+5*nmap<=80, PCG64(860220).
common_statistics.cross_target_family: F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 contains 128 members: BENEFIT and ADVERSE for each of 64 row-policy by column-outcome cells. All eight row policies come from Level-A worker data before conditional Level B. For each condition/column take the verifier block median nHat first, then BENEFIT=max(0,nHat), ADVERSE=max(0,-nHat); mapping rows take min benefit/max adverse; T4 replica adverse is retained. Joint PCG64(860221) inference uses 456 unique verifier runs.
common_statistics.level_b_run_arithmetic: Selected Level-B runs=12*(25*n25+20*n20), n25+n20<=3, maximum 900; T6/T7 have 20 unique cells, all other surfaces 25. No cell deduplication.
common_statistics.cross_target_verifier_denominator: Each condition has 24 paired verifier blocks (six draws x four seeds); require >=20 complete blocks, >=3 verifier seeds, and >=5 draws per cell.
common_statistics.level_a_shape_consistency: phase2_protocol.json#phase2a/level_a_shape_consistency: exact per-target draw rule, >=5 valid seeds per required condition, and >=4 of 6 draws; missing draw fails. This replaces every generic dose-order reference.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Dominant slow-oscillation frequency tracking and entrainment within the model observation proxy.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Welch dominant peak frequency f_SO in 0.4-1.5 Hz; supportive lock metric is SO-to-drive PLV.
targets.units: Hz for f_SO; dimensionless [0,1] for PLV
targets.baseline_value: f0=median f_SO over the 36 paired sham seed-draw blocks; PLV0 is computed against each registered reference frequency. This is a prespecified estimand and is not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Bidirectional movement toward both the registered low drive (0.55 Hz) and high drive (1.15 Hz), with frequency locking rather than a single favorable peak.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: u_E(t)=0.8*sin(2*pi*f_d*t); every other input is zero. Candidate V4 Level-B variables and exact sample schedule are frozen in level_b_execution and its machine binding; no unregistered amplitude, frequency, carrier, phase endpoint, or exposure timing is permitted.
targets.sham_or_no_control: All input channels zero with paired OU streams.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model and pooled fixed-grid frequency policy; unavailable under V4 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged subject frequency policy applied to recipient model; unavailable under V4 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E1=0.5*((abs(f0-0.55)-abs(f_low-0.55))+(abs(f0-1.15)-abs(f_high-1.15))) in Hz, paired by seed and draw; f_low and f_high are outputs at the two registered endpoint drives.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common I_pop, I_wrong, and R_between with G_s equal to the negative mean absolute peak-to-drive error standardized by sham seed uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: E1>=0.05 Hz, PLV>=0.50 at both endpoint drives, and at least 80% of valid blocks move closer to each drive.
targets.decision_threshold: Every T1 F_TARGET_DECISIONS slack has simultaneous lower bound>0: E1-0.05 Hz, both endpoint PLV-0.50, and both move-fraction-0.80; applicable Holm-adjusted p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; all vetoes pass. The exact level_a_shape_consistency prerequisite must pass in >=4 of 6 draws.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap; formal Phase2B uses the frozen nested subject family.
targets.statistical_test: T_obs=mean_b(E1_b/0.05); 100000 one-sided paired sign flips from PCG64(860231); equality is extreme; p=(B+1)/100001.
targets.stability_rule: At least 95% of all prescribed runs stable; no boundary peak, divergence, clipping, saturation, or invalid spectrum.
targets.multiplicity_rule: Primary Holm family T1,T4,T6 at alpha=0.05.
targets.failure_rule: D if valid but any efficacy/robustness threshold fails; F if apparent tracking is forced spectral leakage, boundary selection, instability, detector drift, or protocol violation; NOT_ESTIMABLE if denominators fail.
targets.personalization_requirement: Formal C2 additionally requires N>=3 certified subjects and both interaction contrasts plus R_between to pass the common threshold; synthetic draws do not count.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: bounded generic forcing shifted and locked the dominant slow-frequency proxy within PHASE2_CONTROL_BENCH_V1; non-transferable diagnostic evidence.
targets.prohibited_claim: Personalized entrainment, auditory stimulation efficacy, human slow-wave control, clinical control, C1, C2, or evidence about the unidentified R4 executable.

targets.effect_estimand: E6=bMI(phi=0)-bMI(sham), paired by seed and draw; all phase-grid values are reported.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to bMI gain at that subject's training-selected grid phase minus sham, standardized by within-subject uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: E6>=0.010 absolute bMI and at least 75% of valid blocks have positive paired gain.
targets.decision_threshold: The simultaneous F_TARGET_DECISIONS lower bounds for E6-0.010 and positive-block-fraction-0.75 are both >0, primary Holm-adjusted p<0.05, >=30 valid pairs, >=30 SO cycles and >=10 spindle events per block, and scheduler/surrogate/off-target rules pass. The exact level_a_shape_consistency prerequisite must pass in >=4 of 6 draws.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap including fixed 200-surrogate correction; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.
targets.statistical_test: T_obs=mean_b((bMI(phi=0)-bMI(sham))/0.010); 100000 one-sided paired sign flips from PCG64(860236); equality is extreme; p=(B+1)/100001.
targets.stability_rule: Common rules; all phase bins populated and event counts, SO amplitude, sigma power, and rates remain valid.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin or nonrobust bMI gain; F for edge/filter leakage, trigger-count confounding, event insufficiency presented as zero, packet artifact, unstable rates, or failed surrogate null.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3 and phase-policy differences exceeding within-model uncertainty; unavailable under V4.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: causal phase-triggered generic thalamic packets increased bias-corrected SO-sigma coupling in the clean-room bench.
targets.prohibited_claim: Personalized SO-spindle coordination, human memory consolidation, auditory closed-loop efficacy, C1, C2, or R4 control.

level_b_execution.formula: Exact causal scheduler tuple (phi,A,13); packet u_T=A*Hann500*nonnegative-13-Hz carrier. A=0 emits no packet and logs ZERO_AMPLITUDE_SHAM.
level_b_execution.tie: maximum C6, then A+abs(wrap(phi))/pi, row, column

targets.policy_score: LEVEL_A SINGLE_CONDITION: maximize C6 over all eight unique phase conditions at A=1,f_c=13.
targets.policy_tie_rule: Tie: smaller abs(wrap(phi)), then smaller canonical phi.
targets.cross_target_normalized_scalars: Per verifier block n6_b=(bMI_u,b-bMI_sham,b)/0.010; median blocks before B/A. Then BENEFIT=max(0,nHat) and ADVERSE=max(0,-nHat). Mapping rows aggregate minimum benefit and maximum adverse; bootstrap replicates repeat this exact order.
targets.level_b_policy_tie_rule: maximum C6, then A+abs(wrap(phi))/pi, row, column
targets.shape_consistency_rule: Require >=5 valid paired seeds for every required condition; draw passes exactly as follows: Per draw, median-seed bMI(phi=0)-bMI(sham)>0. Target prerequisite passes iff >=4 of 6 draws pass; equality/missing conventions are frozen in phase2_protocol.json.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Timing of spindle-like maxima relative to slow-oscillation phase.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Circular mean SO phase of the maximum sigma envelope within each retained spindle event.
targets.baseline_value: phi0=paired sham circular mean when resultant length R>=0.20 and event/cycle minima hold; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Measured preferred phase tracks both negative and positive registered trigger offsets rather than merely changing coupling magnitude.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: Same exact causal scheduler as T6. The requested signed phase is canonicalized to [-pi,pi), mapped forward modulo 2*pi to an integer delay from the accepted crossing, and negative offsets are delivered later in the current estimated cycle; no retrospective scheduling or delay calibration is permitted. Candidate V4 Level-B variables and exact sample schedule are frozen in level_b_execution and its machine binding; no unregistered amplitude, frequency, carrier, phase endpoint, or exposure timing is permitted.
targets.sham_or_no_control: Packet amplitude=0 with causal detector running and paired OU streams.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled phase policy; unavailable under V4 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged phase policy; unavailable under V4 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: For each complete block and requested phase alpha_l, beta_b,l=atan2(sum_e sin(phi_e),sum_e cos(phi_e)). For lexicographic pairs l<m, rho_b=sum sin(alpha_l-alpha_m)sin(beta_b,l-beta_b,m)/sqrt(sum sin(alpha_l-alpha_m)^2 * sum sin(beta_b,l-beta_b,m)^2), the Fisher-Lee pairwise circular correlation. Let error_b=median_l abs(wrap(beta_b,l-alpha_l)) radians and separation_b=abs(wrap(beta_b,+pi/2-beta_b,-pi/2)) radians. E7 is (median_b rho_b, median_b error_b, median_b separation_b).
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s=-absolute circular tracking error standardized by sham phase uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: rho_c>=0.70, median tracking error<=pi/6, and lower 95% bound on output separation for requested -pi/2 versus +pi/2 >=pi/3.
targets.decision_threshold: The F_TARGET_DECISIONS simultaneous lower bounds for circular-correlation-0.70, pi/6-minus-tracking-error, and observed separation at the executed -pi/2 and +pi/2 conditions minus pi/3 are all >0; gate-kept Holm-adjusted circular permutation p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; event and concentration minima pass. The exact level_a_shape_consistency prerequisite must pass in >=4 of 6 draws.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS simultaneous bands for rho_c-0.70, pi/6-tracking error, and separation-pi/3; exact circular recomputation in every hierarchical bootstrap. Exact permutation and Holm conventions are separately bound.
targets.statistical_test: Across complete eight-phase Level-A blocks, rho_b is the Fisher-Lee pairwise circular correlation; error_b=median_l abs(wrap(beta-alpha)); separation_b=abs(wrap(beta_(+pi/2)-beta_(-pi/2))). T_obs=min(median rho/0.70,min(4,(pi/6)/max(median error,1e-12)),median separation/(pi/3)). Perform 100000 within-block beta-label permutations from one PCG64(860217) lifecycle; greater tail, equality extreme, degeneracy=-infinity, p=(B+1)/100001.
targets.stability_rule: Common rules plus resultant length R>=0.20; coupling-strength change alone cannot pass T7.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid but poor tracking/separation; F if apparent phase shifts arise only from changed event selection, filter delay, edge leakage, low concentration, or instability; insufficient events are NOT_ESTIMABLE.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3 and subject-specific phase policies exceeding circular uncertainty; unavailable under V4.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: registered trigger offsets shifted spindle-like preferred phase within the clean-room bench, separately from coupling strength.
targets.prohibited_claim: Human spindle timing prescription, personalized phase targeting, causal human timing control, C1, C2, or R4 response.

level_b_execution.formula: Exact causal scheduler tuple (phi,1,f_c); packet u_T=Hann500*0.5*(1+sin(2*pi*f_c*k/1000)); +pi absent.
level_b_execution.policy: MAPPING P7_fc: each of four requested phases maps to (phi,f_c). G7=min(rho_c/0.70,min(4,(pi/6)/max(error,1e-12)),separation/(pi/3)).
level_b_execution.tie: maximum G7, then abs(f_c-13), then smaller f_c

targets.policy_score: LEVEL_A MAPPING: the sole P7_LA maps all eight requested phases to their A=1,f_c=13 cells; G7 is the joint Fisher-Lee rho/tracking/separation score.
targets.cross_target_normalized_scalars: Per verifier block for off-row conditions n7_b=-abs(wrap(beta_u,b-beta_sham,b))/(pi/6); median blocks before B/A. Diagonal T7 uses verifier G7 of the eight-condition mapping. Then BENEFIT=max(0,nHat) and ADVERSE=max(0,-nHat). Mapping rows aggregate minimum benefit and maximum adverse; bootstrap replicates repeat this exact order.
targets.level_b_policy_score: MAPPING P7_fc: each of four requested phases maps to (phi,f_c). G7=min(rho_c/0.70,min(4,(pi/6)/max(error,1e-12)),separation/(pi/3)).
targets.level_b_policy_tie_rule: maximum G7, then abs(f_c-13), then smaller f_c
targets.shape_consistency_rule: Require >=5 valid paired seeds for every required condition; draw passes exactly as follows: Per draw, complete seed-aggregated eight-phase curve with Fisher-Lee rho>0 and +/-pi/2 separation>0. Target prerequisite passes iff >=4 of 6 draws pass; equality/missing conventions are frozen in phase2_protocol.json.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Transition between prospectively defined model dynamical regimes, not a clinical sleep-state transition.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Fraction of six adjacent 25 s windows [15,40),[40,65),[65,90),[90,115),[115,140),[140,165) s satisfying every mixed SO-spindle model-regime criterion.
targets.detector_metric_implementation: phase2_protocol.json#observation_and_detector_contract/T8; each 25 s window uses Hann Welch fs=200,nperseg=5000,noverlap=0,nfft=10000, with global 180 s filtering, sham threshold calibration over [10,170) s, and strict within-window event containment.
targets.baseline_value: O0=sham mixed-regime occupancy across the six exact 25 s windows in each paired block and its median; prespecified and not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Demonstrate a persistent bidirectional occupancy range across inhibitory/reticular versus excitatory/relay forcing without silence, saturation, or transient instability.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: For d>=0 inject (u_E,u_T)=(d,0.5d); for d<0 inject (u_I,u_R)=(-d,-0.5d); unused inputs zero. Candidate V4 Level-B variables and exact sample schedule are frozen in level_b_execution and its machine binding; no unregistered amplitude, frequency, carrier, phase endpoint, or exposure timing is permitted.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled regime policy; unavailable under V4 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged regime policy; unavailable under V4 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E8=max_d O(d)-min_d O(d) over the complete fixed grid, paired by seed and draw; extrema use smallest absolute dose then smaller signed dose for ties.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to occupancy gain toward the registered mixed regime, standardized by within-subject uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: E8>=1/3; at d_hi, at least 75% of complete blocks have two consecutive valid-regime windows and the simultaneous lower bound for persistence fraction-0.75 is >0; at least one exact pair among (-2,-1.25),(-1.25,-0.5),(0.5,1.25),(1.25,2) has Q(d)>0 at both doses.
targets.decision_threshold: The F_TARGET_DECISIONS simultaneous lower bounds for E8-1/3 and persistence_fraction(d_hi)-0.75 are both >0; >=30 valid paired blocks; exact Level-A adjacency and >=4/6 draw shape rules pass; all component/hard stability rules pass. T8 is exploratory and ineligible for V4 advancement.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS simultaneous bands jointly include E8-1/3 and persistence_fraction(d_hi)-0.75; exact adjacency and shape rules are noncompensatory binary prerequisites.
targets.statistical_test: T_obs=mean_b((max_d O(d)-min_d O(d))/(1/3)); 100000 one-sided paired sign flips from PCG64(860238); equality extreme; p=(B+1)/100001; descriptive only.
targets.minimum_denominators: [object Object] Persistence and Q(d) use the same complete paired blocks; every support dose requires >=30 blocks, >=5 seeds, and >=5 draws.
targets.stability_rule: Every regime-positive window must meet all registered rate, SO, spindle, spectral, and solver bounds; silence, saturation, clipping, or transient blow-up is INVALID.
targets.multiplicity_rule: Exploratory descriptive target; ineligible for Candidate V4 Phase2B advancement.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin or nonpersistent occupancy response; F if a transition is caused by instability, silence, saturation, clipping, detector collapse, or a single isolated window.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3 would be required in a new protocol version; unavailable under V4.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: balanced generic forcing changed occupancy of a prospectively defined model regime in PHASE2_CONTROL_BENCH_V1.
targets.prohibited_claim: Sleep-stage transition in humans, movement toward a clinically beneficial attractor, personalized state control, C1, C2, or R4 response.

level_b_execution.formula: In each analysis-relative 25,000-step window [a0,a1), L=floor(25000*fraction+0.5), start=a0+floor((25000-L)/2), stop=start+L; apply GF_BALANCED_DC only on [start,stop).
level_b_execution.policy: SINGLE_CONDITION: at fixed fraction, a nonzero dose is eligible only when it belongs to passing pair (-2,-1) or (1,2), both Q_f values are >0, and C8=min(oriented occupancy/(1/6),persistence_fraction/0.75) is estimable.

targets.policy_score: LEVEL_A SINGLE_CONDITION: among doses belonging to one of the exact strict passing adjacency pairs, maximize C8=min(oriented occupancy/(1/6),persistence_fraction/0.75).
targets.policy_tie_rule: Tie: smaller abs(d), then smaller signed d.
targets.cross_target_normalized_scalars: Per verifier block n8_b=(O_u,b-O_sham,b)/(1/6); median blocks before B/A. Then BENEFIT=max(0,nHat) and ADVERSE=max(0,-nHat). Mapping rows aggregate minimum benefit and maximum adverse; bootstrap replicates repeat this exact order.
targets.level_b_policy_score: At each fraction, G8(d,f)=C8(d,f) only for cells belonging to a strict passing same-fraction pair (-2,-1) or (1,2); missing/equality fails.
targets.shape_consistency_rule: Require >=5 valid paired seeds for every required condition; draw passes exactly as follows: Per draw, at least one exact same-sign adjacency pair has both oriented occupancy medians >0 and >=75% of valid seeds persist at draw-level d_hi. Target prerequisite passes iff >=4 of 6 draws pass; equality/missing conventions are frozen in phase2_protocol.json.
